definition: Concrete job loss, wage depression, and economic disruption caused by AI adoption in existing industries. Focuses on documented and measurable workforce impacts rather than abstract productivity gains or creative destruction narratives.
rationale_for_coinage: Skeptics treat labor displacement as a concrete, measurable harm — jobs lost, wages depressed, communities disrupted. Accelerationists frame the same phenomenon as 'creative destruction' (positive) or 'workforce transition' (neutral). The bare term 'displacement' hides this evaluative divergence.

do_not_confuse_with.note: Documented present harm is the broader category; labor displacement is a specific instance of present harm focused on economic impacts.

contested_aspects: Whether AI displaces more jobs than it creates
Whether displaced workers can realistically transition to new roles
Whether displacement is a temporary adjustment or permanent structural shift
